scoring_justification: Verifier cannot rerun heavy AIMD simulations; compares agent's reported structural results against paper gold with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold Fe-Pb distances, Se-Fe distance, and contact ion pair stability
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Fe-Pb distances from Trajectory B (101) and Trajectory G (210); Se-Fe average from static selenite optimization; stability from Trajectory I description.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported trajectory-averaged and static distances and the qualitative statement of stability.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the actual paper-reported numbers, used as the reproduction target; verified against solve.sh.

outputs.description: Reproduced structural parameters: time-averaged Fe-Pb distances from AIMD, Se-Fe distance from static DFT, and stability of the contact ion pair.

output_contract.notes: All distances are in angstroms. The checker compares each numeric field to the hidden paper-reported value with a prescribed tolerance, and checks the boolean against the paper's result. Reward is the fraction of the five fields that match.

steps.description: Compare agent's reported structural parameters against paper reference.
